general.title: General

publicPage.title: Public page
publicPage.description: How your public changelog looks and who can find it.

publicPage.customDomainDescription: Serve your changelog from your own domain, like changelog.acme.com.

widget.title: Widget
widget.description: Show your latest updates inside your product with a small badge and popup.
widget.installDescription: Paste this snippet where you want the badge to appear, for example next to a “What's new” link.
widget.snippetBadgeComment: The badge will appear inside this element
widget.snippetSpaComment: In your component, once the script has loaded:
widget.headwayNote: Coming from Headway? Your existing snippet works as is: just replace the script URL with {url} and the account ID with yours.
widget.spaDescription: Load the script once and initialize the widget when the badge element is mounted. Call destroy() when it unmounts.
widget.previewDescription: The real widget on a sample page. It refreshes after you save.
widget.previewHint: Click the badge to open the widget. Publish a post to see it here.
widget.previewFailed: The widget script couldn't be loaded. Check that WIDGET_URL points to this instance.
widget.behaviorDescription: Fine-tune how the badge and the popup behave.

eyecatcherModes.onDescription: The badge pulses gently when there's something new.
eyecatcherModes.progressiveDescription: The animation gets more noticeable after a few visits with unread posts.

widget.softHide: Keep a quiet badge when there’s nothing new
widget.softHideDescription: Instead of disappearing when everything is read, the badge shrinks to a small grey dot.
widget.textsDescription: Override the built-in texts for each language. Leave a field empty to use the default.
widget.stickyFooterDescription: Pin the link to the bottom of the widget. When off, it appears after the last entry.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Labels such as “New” or “Fix” that help readers scan your updates.
categories.createDescription: It's created in your default language; you can translate it below.
categories.name: Name

categories.listDescriptionLocales: Click a name to rename or translate it. Drag rows or use the arrows to reorder.
categories.deleteDescription: Posts using this category keep their content but lose this label. This cannot be undone.

languages.title: Languages
languages.description: Publish your changelog in several languages from a single workspace.
languages.languagesDescription: Choose which languages you write in.
languages.defaultLocaleHint: New posts are written in this language first and it's used as the fallback.
languages.enabledHint: Each post can be translated into these languages. The default language can't be disabled.

policy.fallback: Show it in the default language
policy.fallbackDescription: Readers see the original version with a short notice.
policy.hideDescription: The post only appears in the languages it has been translated into.

languages.explainerBody: You don't need a separate widget per language. The widget detects the language from the lang attribute of your page's html tag or from the visitor's browser, and the public page offers a language switcher.
languages.explainerForce: To force a language, add language: "es" to the widget configuration.

team.title: Team
team.description: People who can write and manage this changelog.
team.inviteDescription: They'll get an email with a link to join. Invitations expire after 14 days.
team.membersDescription: Change roles or remove people from this workspace.
team.membersReadOnly: Only owners and admins can manage members.
team.transferDescription: {name} will become an owner and you'll become an admin. Only owners can delete the workspace or transfer it.
team.removeDescription: They'll lose access to this workspace immediately. Their posts stay published.
team.leaveDescription: You'll lose access until someone invites you again.
team.leaveDescriptionOwner: You'll lose access until someone invites you again. If you're the only owner, transfer ownership first.
team.pendingDescription: Invitations that haven't been accepted yet.

roles.ownerDescription: Full control, including deleting the workspace and transferring ownership.
roles.adminDescription: Manages settings, categories, the widget, API keys and members. Can edit any post.
roles.editorDescription: Writes, edits and publishes posts. Can't change settings or manage the team.

api.title: API & MCP
api.description: Let your scripts, CI and AI agents read and publish updates.

publishing.title: Integrations can publish
publishing.description: When off (recommended), the API and MCP create and edit drafts, and when they publish the post goes to the review queue (Posts → Pending review) for a person to approve. When on, keys with the publish scope and authorized MCP apps can publish, schedule and edit live posts.

keys.title: API keys
keys.description: Workspace keys for the REST API and the MCP server. Treat them like passwords.
keys.name: Name
keys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it will stop working immediately.
keys.secretDescription: For security, it won't be shown again.

mcp.title: Connect AI agents (MCP)
mcp.description: Featherlog speaks the Model Context Protocol: agents can draft, translate and publish posts.
mcp.claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the URL and sign in. No key needed.
mcp.cursorTitle: Cursor / other clients (with an API key)
mcp.stdio: For clients that only support local servers:

rest.description: OpenAPI 3.1 with idempotency keys, ETags and problem+json errors.
